content: We conduct this experiment for all users with the best performing model for this approach, i.e. we use BERT embeddings as features, and MLP for classification. We train this classifier for 40 iterations, and compare the model's performance when we use the same set of negative examples vs. when we randomly sample new negative examples in each iteration.
